checks.name: Playground boots the Projects surface without page errors
checks.observation: no pageerror, DOM populated

checks.name: Gantt task-list width is a share of the host, not a constant
checks.observation: host 1256 -> 376px, host 976 -> 292px (0.30 clamped to 280-560)

checks.name: A dragged task-list width is remembered across a remount
checks.observation: drag +150px -> stored -> reload keeps it -> clearing it returns to adaptive

checks.name: The Gantt task cell fills its column, and keeps filling it after a drag
checks.observation: cell width tracks .wx-content (354 at a 370px column, 544 at 560)

checks.name: The Gantt timescale stays opaque: rows scrolling under it stay hidden
checks.observation: the scale band renders identically at scrollTop 0 and 300, and its background is opaque

checks.name: Gantt renders bars, rows and an ISO week scale
checks.observation: bars > 0 and week labels present

checks.name: Bar width equals the inclusive day count (due day included)
checks.observation: launch=5d, docs=6d, long=161d ± 0.5px

checks.name: Row metadata shows the inclusive due date, not the exclusive boundary
checks.observation: launch ends on due date, not due+1

checks.name: Week headers are ISO-8601 week numbers
checks.observation: each label matches getISOWeek

checks.name: Undated items stay visible: header count, drawer and bar count agree
checks.observation: 2 unscheduled items listed, 4 bars drawn

checks.name: Week/day time axis: 24-hour labels, ~10 hours visible, opens at 08:00
checks.observation: labels HH:00, 72px/hour, viewport starts at 08:00

checks.name: Hour rules are drawn in the time grids and NOT in the month grid
checks.observation: month date cells flat, week body columns lined

checks.name: Gantt keeps its frame when nothing is scheduled, with no overlay
checks.observation: task column + scale render, nothing drawn on top

checks.name: Gantt header carries the shared controls
checks.observation: project filter + search left, Today centred, segments + New Task right, 42px

checks.name: Calendar and Gantt remember their view across a remount
checks.observation: mode/scale persist per workspace

checks.name: Calendar (FullCalendar) renders with our header and no library toolbar
checks.observation: entries > 0, .fc toolbar buttons = 0

checks.name: A single click on an empty slot opens the editor on exactly that one slot
checks.observation: click 13:00 -> the shared editor is seeded 13:00-13:30, not a default hour

checks.name: The Playground registers a working preview for every Project Management view
checks.observation: overview / list / board / calendar / gantt all mount something

checks.name: The live-navigation surface the create/edit checks drive is registered
checks.observation: projects-surface-live opens the Projects surface from a real route

checks.name: Day and week headers carry two lines, the month header one, all the same height
checks.observation: 52px in 日/周/月; 日/周 show weekday+date and mark today, 月 shows the weekday only

checks.name: The all-day row is gone from 日/周 and the rail holds every untimed entry instead
checks.observation: no all-day lane; rail is 300px; month keeps its chips and has no rail

checks.name: Dragging a rail entry to the grid edge scrolls the grid while the pointer holds still
checks.observation: scrollTop advances to the end of the range with the preview still following

checks.name: A narrow panel collapses the rail into a header chip that opens the same list
checks.observation: wide panel -> rail; narrow panel -> chip, and the chip still lists every untimed entry

checks.name: Dropping a rail entry on the grid writes that date and time
checks.observation: rail -> grid: {date, time, allDay:false}, and the entry leaves the rail

checks.name: Dropping a timed entry on the rail clears its time and keeps its date
checks.observation: grid -> rail: {date unchanged, allDay:true}, and the entry returns to the rail

checks.name: The rail's + creates an entry from a title and a date alone
checks.observation: create: {title, date, allDay:true} with no time invented

checks.name: Month overflow is reachable: a 5-entry day exposes the rest through "+N more"
checks.observation: overflow control opens and lists every hidden entry

checks.name: Out-of-window timed entries render inside the time grid (07:00 and 22:00)
checks.observation: both entries present and contained by [role=grid]

checks.name: Calendar entries are keyboard-reachable (the old chips were unfocusable divs)
checks.observation: every entry has tabindex >= 0 and a pointer cursor

checks.name: A range drawn on the calendar opens the shared editor already planned
checks.observation: drag 5 slots from 09:00 -> editor seeded 09:00-11:30 -> createRequest.planning matches

checks.name: A rejected create keeps the shared editor open and says why
checks.observation: error toast shown, editor still mounted
